status: Synthetic generator SYN-001/1.0.0 (EXP-001 to EXP-003); UCI Adult downloaded and adopted for EXP-004 (second test on a real score distribution), owner-approved 2026-11-24
licence_note: Third-party data keep their own licences. Original synthetic data products are covered by NOTICE.md.

synthetic.description: Two-group latent-qualification generator: Q ~ Normal(mu_g, s_g^2), Y = 1[Q > 0], X = Q + Normal(0, sigma_g^2). Groups A and B are abstract and represent no real population. Latent family Gaussian (primary), Student t3 or shifted log-normal (EXP-003), standardised to unit variance.
synthetic.seeds: confirmatory 0-19 per cell (frozen); exploratory 1000 and above
synthetic.regeneration_command: scripts/rigged smoke --matrix SMOKE | SIZING | DEGEN (exploratory); scripts/rigged run --experiment EXP-NNN (after the owner's freeze)

external.name: UCI Adult
external.citation: Becker, B. and Kohavi, R. (1996). Adult [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5XW20
external.licence: CC BY 4.0. Dataset page, opened 2026-11-24: "This dataset is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license." Matches the owner's approvals file (section 1: UCI Adult, CC BY 4.0).
external.attribution: Becker and Kohavi (1996), UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0. The archive is redistributed unchanged.
external.personal_identifiers: none direct (census-derived extract, no names or IDs); demographic attributes present. Only age, education-num, capital-gain, capital-loss, hours-per-week, sex (EXP-004 primary group attribute, owner's decision of 2026-11-24, round 3; not a score input) and the income label are used.
external.commit_rule: CC BY and under 20 MB: committed (owner approvals 2026-11-24b, section 1, redistribution rule)
external.use: EXP-004 only. Score model fitted on adult.data (JRN-0005); second test on adult.test (protocol section 13, rounds 2 and 3; primary group attribute sex, secondary hours-per-week below 40). No synthetic parameter is calibrated on it.
external.decision: adopted (DEC-011), supersedes the 'not used' entry of DEC-003 for EXP-004 only
